title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Late-Evidence Retention on Overlap Credits
content:
The **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** overlap schedule keeps part of the overlap credit when the borrower's evidence reaches Tidemark long after the borrower's own coverage began.

**Late-evidence retention.** Tidemark keeps, without taking the overlap credit below zero, 75 dollars of it when the evidence was received more than 365 days after the borrower's coverage start, keeps 35 dollars when it was received more than 180 but at most 365 days after it, and keeps nothing otherwise.

Both dates come from the evidence used: its received date and the effective date it shows. Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included. The amount kept is taken off the overlap credit only once every amount added to the credit has been added, and it never takes the credit below zero.

**Condition – result**
- Received 180 days or fewer after the coverage start (or before it): nothing kept.
- Received 181 to 365 days after: 35 dollars kept.
- Received 366 days or more after: 75 dollars kept.

*Hypothetical:* coverage start 1 February, evidence received 31 July of the same non-leap year — 180 days, nothing kept; received 1 August — 181 days, 35 dollars kept.
